chat.data_readonly_banner: Data is read-only — memory, learning, history and settings are not saved.
chat.data_readonly_toast: Started with read-only data (for example, it was written by a newer version). Chat works, but memory, learning, history and settings are not saved.
chat.syntax_checker_missing_banner: The syntax checker (tree-sitter-language-pack) is missing. Restart with the .venv Python to enable syntax checks for non-Python files.
chat.served_model_mismatch_banner: llama-server is running {served}, not the configured {expected}. Restart llama-server to use the configured model.
chat.format_health_banner: {count} data format(s) could not be read or saved (written by a newer version, damaged, save failed, etc.). Run evoref doctor for details.
chat.reembed_pending_banner: The embedding model has changed. Memory search is limited for {count} store(s) until they are re-embedded with the new model.
chat.edition_switched_to_pro: Switched from Free to Pro. The Pro data formats have been created; your existing memory, learning and history carry over.
chat.edition_switched_to_free: Switched from Pro to Free. Pro-only data (LoRA, evaluation sets and so on) is kept but not used. It is used again when you switch back to Pro.
chat.edition_build_mismatch: The backend is running Free, but this UI was built for Pro. Pro features are unavailable (restart the UI with VITE_EVOREF_EDITION=free).
chat.reembed_started: Re-embedding started in the background. Memory search returns to normal once it finishes.
chat.mode_restarting: Switching models. Please wait until it finishes...
chat.search_history_no_match: search_history: no match in past conversations
chat.input_truncated: ⚠ Only the beginning of this message was sent due to the length limit ({sent} / {original} chars). The rest never reached the AI, so counts or totals over the whole text may be inaccurate.
chat.output_truncated: ⚠ The output token limit was reached, so this response is cut off. Send "continue" to generate the rest.
chat.input_truncated_toast: Message too long — only the beginning was sent
chat.create_reattached: Reconnected to the previous creation run. Restoring progress…

create_run_unfinished.incomplete: The creation did not complete: some generation or verification steps failed. Please review the delivered artifacts.
create_run_unfinished.failed: The creation ended abnormally. The delivered artifacts may be partial.
create_run_unfinished.cancelled: The creation was cancelled. Delivering the partial artifacts.
create_run_unfinished.timeout: The creation hit its time limit. Delivering the partial artifacts.

chat.send_blocked_while_streaming: Cannot send while a response is streaming. Your text is kept - send it once the response finishes.
chat.long_form_quality_issue: Generated ({total} units) — quality check flagged issues

sidebar.mode_chat_desc: Chat: the conversation is the deliverable. Read-only (documents can still be generated)
sidebar.mode_create_desc: Create: owns a workspace — edit existing files, run commands, build multi-file projects

dashboard.growth_auto_effective: On (qualifying candidates are adopted and rolled back automatically on regression)

dashboard.growth_auto_waiting: Enabled but waiting for its conditions — candidates are kept as proposals ({reason})

model_migrate.migrate_only_hint: Edited via the migration button (config save does not change model paths).

settings.applied_restart_required: Settings saved. A backend restart is required for them to take effect

system.title: Environment tuning
system.description: Measures and proposes values that depend on this PC (RAM / VRAM / GPU / cores). Items you set explicitly in config.yaml are never overwritten.
system.restart_required: A restart is required to apply these. Restart llama-server from the server control in the Model tab.
system.status_requires_stop: Stop required (run the CLI while stopped)
system.status_requires_explicit: Not measured by a full run while running (run this item by name)
system.status_manual_rows: Not applied: set manually (see the proposed value on the left)
system.status_not_auto: Not applied: not set to auto
system.status_no_samples: No measurements yet; running with current values

develop.title: Danger Zone
develop.description: Developer-only maintenance actions. These are destructive and only available in the Develop edition.
develop.reset_hint: Delete learning, memory, history, logs and caches in the data root (userdata/ by default); outputs / themes / profiles are kept. All services stop and exit (restart manually).
develop.warning: This is irreversible. All learning history, memory, conversation history, prompt evolution, logs, and caches in the data root (including Pro learning data) will be permanently deleted.
develop.confirm_body: All services (llama-server + backend + frontend) will stop, the data root will be reset (outputs / themes / profiles are kept), and the helper will exit. This tab will be closed automatically (close it manually if it is not). Restart manually afterwards. Continue?
develop.stopped_body: Please close this tab. Restart manually (e.g. scripts/evoref-ctl.bat start).
develop.unavailable: This page is only available in the Develop edition.

runtimes.desc: Executables Create uses to check the syntax of generated files (php -l / node --check). Leave empty to search PATH. Each row is saved with its Apply button, not with the tab's Apply.

server.host_remote_without_allow: This host is reachable from outside, but allow_remote is false. To use it from a LAN, set server.allow_remote to true in config.yaml (a token becomes mandatory)
server.allow_remote_without_remote_host: allow_remote is true but the host is local to this PC. Change the host as well to use it from a LAN
server.allow_remote_on: allow_remote: enabled (token required). Change it only in config.yaml
server.allow_remote_off: allow_remote: disabled. Change it only in config.yaml

i18n.prompt_locale_confirm: Switching the prompt language will archive current prompts and replace them with defaults in the new language. Auto re-learning will be scheduled. Continue?
i18n.prompt_locale_switched_with_relearn: Prompt language switched. Re-learning has been scheduled

llama.max_tokens_desc: Upper limit of one reply (0 = up to the remaining context)

rag.rerank_note: Port, GPU placement and other details are set in config.yaml. Without a model (model_paths.rerank_model) it does not start even when on

reindex.targets: Targets: RAG {rag} chunks / cartridges {cart} chunks / memory {mem} notes
reindex.done: Reindex complete: RAG {rag} / cartridges {cart} / memory {mem} notes ({sec}s)

reembed.restart_note: Embedding model changed: the manifest was swapped and facts reembedded. Restart the backend so live recall uses the new vectors.

threshold.hint: Adjust retrieval thresholds after switching the embedding model (run reindex first).
threshold.calibrate_note: Heuristic suggestions from the rebuilt vectors (advisory, not auto-applied).
threshold.advisory: Suggested values (heuristic from score distribution — review before applying):
threshold.distribution: Based on {n} vectors. match top1 p50={matchp50}, unrelated p95={bgp95}.
threshold.applied_restart_required: Thresholds saved. Restart the backend to apply them.
threshold.insufficient: Not enough vectors to calibrate ({n}). Reindex first.

memory.retention_note: Excess records are trimmed oldest first (pinned ones excepted). Takes effect after a restart

pins.note: Pinned memories are exempt from retention trimming. Changes take effect immediately (no Apply needed)
pins.load_failed: Could not load the pinned list
pins.force_confirm: This pin is locked. Unpin it anyway?

pro.knowledge_enabled_desc: Visits the registered sources during idle sleep-time and ingests knowledge. Does nothing when no source is registered

schedule.local_tz_desc: IANA name used for learning time-of-day decisions such as night runs (e.g. Asia/Tokyo, UTC)

local_paths.outputs_dir: Default output directory (relative to the data root)
local_paths.outputs_dir_desc: Read-only here. Change it in config.yaml (local_paths.outputs_dir).

tools.fetch_url_reenable_note: It cannot be re-enabled from the UI. To enable it, set tools.fetch_url_enabled to true in config.yaml.

prompts.rollback_discard_confirm: Discard your unsaved edits and roll back to version {version}?
prompts.protected_warning: <!-- PROTECTED --> sections are preserved during evolution
prompts.unsaved_changes: You have unsaved changes. Discard them?

model_card.saved_restart: Saved. Restart the server to apply.
model_card.create_shared_note: The create model runs on the same server as the base model and uses the base model's launch options.

project_map.description: An index of the code structure in your working folders. Create mode uses it to find related files; it is normally updated automatically while idle.

cartridgeTrust.title: Signatures and trust store
cartridgeTrust.hint: Only cartridges signed by your organization are installed with their bundled index (prebuilt), without re-embedding. Add and revoke keys with `evoref cartridge trust add` / `evoref cartridge revoke` while evoref is stopped.

status.digest_mismatch: Content does not match the signature

orgPolicy.title: Organization policy pack
orgPolicy.hint: A pack signed and distributed by your organization's administrator pins the prompts, generation parameters, usable tools and models. Apply / detach a pack and write a proposal bundle with evoref stopped: `evoref policy apply` / `detach` / `bundle`.
orgPolicy.loadError: Could not load the policy state: {error}
orgPolicy.notApplied: No organization policy pack is applied. Nothing is pinned.
orgPolicy.expired: This pack has expired. The pins stay; ask the administrator for the next pack.
orgPolicy.drift: A pinned item was changed by editing the files directly. This is not enforced; re-apply with `evoref policy apply`.
orgPolicy.modelNotAllowed: The running model is not in the allowed list

teamHub.title: Team knowledge hub
teamHub.hint: Only the know.* claims and documents marked as published are exported as a signed cartridge to a shared folder; members install newer versions. Publishing, exporting and syncing are done with `evoref hub publish` / `export` / `sync`.
teamHub.loadError: Could not read the hub state: {error}
teamHub.notPublishing: Nothing is marked as published (nothing is exported by default).
teamHub.summary: Hub {name}: {claims} claim(s) and {documents} document(s) marked as published

modelFit.title: Model fit lab
modelFit.hint: Results of evaluating the candidate models under models/ with the bundled scenarios (and, if you chose, your regression ledger) while evoref was stopped. Run evaluations with `evoref modelfit run` and switch with `evoref model migrate` (nothing is switched automatically).
modelFit.loadError: Could not read the evaluation results: {error}
modelFit.none: No evaluation yet (`evoref modelfit plan` shows the plan and the time it takes).
modelFit.pendingRestore: A previous evaluation ended without restoring config.yaml. Stop evoref and run `evoref modelfit recover`.
modelFit.runSummary: Last evaluation: {at} / {scenarios} scenarios, {turns} turns per model, {ledger} regression ledger cases
modelFit.limits: The scenarios reproduce defects fixed in past audits, not your usual mix of requests. SE is a lower bound.

reason.pass_rate_significant: its pass rate is higher than every other model by more than 2 standard errors
reason.equivalent_faster: pass rates are within noise and its response time is clearly shorter
reason.no_significant_difference: pass rates are within noise and response times are not clearly different
reason.ledger_disagrees: {candidate} leads on the pass rate but is significantly worse on your regression ledger

knowledge.hint: Registered sources are fetched during idle sleep-time and turned into know.* claims. This screen only edits the ledger.
knowledge.name: Name
knowledge.unblocked_notice: Unblocked "{name}". Enable it to resume fetching.
knowledge.delete_confirm_message: Block "{name}"? Information already fetched from it is dropped from use at the next cleanup. You can unblock it later.

fewshot.title: Learned Examples
fewshot.page_description: Learned examples are picked automatically from past exchanges that went well and serve as models when answering similar questions. Pinned examples stay; moved-to-storage examples are no longer used (you can bring them back at any time). See the dashboard for overall learning progress.

audit.hint: For every answer, the IDs of the material used, the cartridges, the model, the prompt version and the number of external calls are recorded in a hash-chained ledger. Texts are not recorded. Tampering is detectable, not prevented.
audit.head: Chain head
audit.load_failed: Could not load the audit trail status: {detail}
audit.head_note: Keep the chain head hash outside the ledger (for example with a copy of a report). Checking it next time also detects a truncated tail.
